hooks.command: payload=$(cat); via=${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-${TASKS_SESSION:-${CODEX_THREAD_ID:-}}}; case "${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:+${AI_AGENT:-}}" in *_agent) case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/agent-*) agent=${PWD##*/.claude/worktrees/agent-}; agent=${agent%%/*}; case "$agent" in ''|*[!0-9a-f]*) ;; *) via=$agent ;; esac ;; esac ;; esac; if answer=$(printf %s "$payload" | curl --fail --silent --connect-timeout 0.1 --max-time 2 --header "x-via: $via" --header 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @- 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/session/hook'); then printf '%s\n' "$answer"; else printf %s "$payload" | yak session context --hook - || true; fi
